name: Testing with pytest
description: Write tests that catch your mistakes before they reach a backtest.

lessonNames.l9-logic-apart: Separating logic from input and output

lessonObjectives.l1-code-that-checks: See a test catch a broken change before it does damage.
lessonObjectives.l2-first-test: Write a test function and run it with pytest.
lessonObjectives.l3-reading-failure: Read pytest’s failure report and find the cause.
lessonObjectives.l5-empty-one-many: Choose the edge cases a function must survive.
lessonObjectives.l6-many-inputs: Parametrise a test over a table of cases.
lessonObjectives.l7-shared-data: Use fixtures to share test data between tests.
lessonObjectives.l8-failing-properly: Assert that bad input raises the right error.
lessonObjectives.l9-logic-apart: Refactor a script so its logic can be tested on its own.
lessonObjectives.l10-test-first: Write a failing test, then the code that passes it.
lessonObjectives.l11-testing-drawdown: Test a maximum drawdown function on hand-made price paths.
lessonObjectives.l12-every-push: Run your tests automatically on GitHub after every push.
